LESSON: HADITH ON GRATITUDE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on Greetings (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the le
Topic 2.4: Hadith on Gratitude

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on Gratitude. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should one be grateful to other people?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation
2. practise gratitude in day-to- day life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation
   In simple words: practise until you can read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. practise gratitude in day-to- day life
   In simple words: practise until you can practise gratitude in day-to- day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on Gratitude using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on Gratitude in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on Gratitude to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on Gratitude.
4. Show that you can: read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Gratitude using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Gratitude important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read from a chart/digital device the Hadith on gratitude: “Whoever is never thankful to people is never thankful to Allah.” (Al-Tirmithi),
2. Discuss the lessons learnt from the Hadith and make class presentations,
3. Communication and collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking and teamwork as learners discuss the lessons learnt from the Hadith and make class presentations.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation
2. practise gratitude in day-to- day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
